messages.msg: Q15 proves which components a state update renders on App > ArticleList > ArticleCard (three cards) > CommentBox, each logging its name: a Like on the first card logs that ArticleCard and its CommentBox, twice each with Strict Mode, and nothing from App, ArticleList, or the other cards; CommentBox renders though its output is the same, and the commit changes one text node. Q54 can add the parent and context causes of a re-render on the same tree instead of building a new one.
